title: Discover deep entry leaves an actionable dialog on a detached Home fragment
reproduction: Show DOWNLOAD_FAILED; deliver EXTRA_NAV_DISCOVER to the existing singleTop Home activity while the dialog is open; try its Sources action.
expected: Discover is usable; Home offers recovery on return until the user acknowledges it.
observed: Source trace: replace destroys the Home view but not the activity-owned window. The beta Sources callback calls requireActivity on the removed fragment.
fix: Dismiss the view-owned recovery dialog without consuming the error on teardown; ignore callbacks from replaced dialogs.
test_evidence: New deep-entry regression authored; source-reviewed only.

title: Acknowledging an old download error hides newer status text
reproduction: While the recovery prompt is open publish a newer status line; acknowledge the failed download.
expected: Only the prompt clears; the newer status remains visible.
observed: Source trace: acknowledgeError emits null; notifyError animated the status to GONE before testing for null. No further status event is required to follow.
fix: Only hide state text for an actual error; a cleared error does not change status visibility.
test_evidence: New status-after-acknowledgement regression authored; source-reviewed only.
